steps.npc: Make [sword style] sword.

options.condition: If the player has a commission:

steps.npc: Go make [sword style] sword.

options.text: I'm not sure what something does.

steps.player: I'm not sure what something does.

steps.npc: What do not understand, little one?

options.text: How do I use the crucible?

steps.player: How do I use the crucible?

steps.npc: Crucible just a big bucket... We put metal in and it melt it down to make swords.
Crucible let us add differing metals... and can store up to 28 metal bar worth, Kovac think.
We can put other metal thing in too, like sword and armour.
Need help with anything else?

options.text: What does the mould jig do?

steps.player: What does the mould jig do?

steps.npc: Mould jig very handy... It let us make differing type of sword.
We want use mould parts to fit condi... commission... so when setting up mould, find parts that match.
Some match commission better than other... so find best one for job.
Need help with anything else?

options.text: How do I control the preform's temperature?

steps.player: How do I control the preform's temperature?

steps.npc: That very easy... If preform too cold, dunk in lava... If preform too hot, hold to waterfall.
Preform need to be right temperature to work with tool.
Trip hammer need preform to be hot... Grindstone need preform to be warm... Polishing wheel need preform to be cold.
Need help with anything else?

options.text: When should I use a tool?

steps.player: When should I use a tool?

steps.npc: Hmm... Kovac think it a gut feeling thing...
Hmm... that is true.

steps.text: Progress on your sword can be tracked via the display on screen. You can track which tool you need to use via the completion bar.
Use the preform on the trip hammer when your completion tracker is over this icon's bar.
Use the preform on the grindstone when your completion tracker is over this icon's bar.
Use the preform on the polishing wheel when your completion tracker is over this icon's bar.

steps.npc: Need help with anything else?
Okay.

options.text: I'm not sure what something does, can you help me?
options.condition: If the player has a commission:

options.text: Can I scrap my current commission?
options.condition: If the player has a commission:

steps.player: Can I scrap my current commission?

steps.npc: Why want that?

steps.player: I don't think I'm really feeling it at the moment.

steps.npc: That okay, Kovac will give reward even if sword bad. Maybe you put in storage for working later, but Kovac no scrap swords.
Here's what Kovac have.
Okay friend, Kovac here to help.
